edits.new: The valid-from date 2026-11-20 is the date the legacy story's background uses for the version in force. The read-model objects v_data_product_catalog and v_data_dictionary are not LDM v9 or Data Classification v5 entities or fields; they are read models of this slice and carry no BR Field ID. The data steward closes the rest of DPA-2026.11 by a later approved load before the version is relied on outside SIT; no row is granted by default.

disposition.note: Size row now states the story fits within two weeks as INVEST Small.
BR6 names open decision DL26 with assumptions ASM-0247, ASM-0264, ASM-0275 and ASM-0355.
Section 5 has a Covered by column mapping X1 to X8 to ACs in section 7.
Section 8 has a Covered by column naming the AC per rule. Section 16 test rows are not in this chunk and were not checked.
Six seed rows now carry DF-REF-080 to DF-REF-086; read-model objects are noted as not LDM or DC entities.

disposition.change: Publish GET /api/recovery/source-data/v1/entry-candidates with businessDate and threshold required, page and size optional; response EntryCandidatePage with businessDate, threshold, asOf, page, size, total, candidates[] and breaks[]; candidate elements named after the field they read; statuses 400, 401, 403, 409, 422, 503; access by the rwb-case service identity.
disposition.note: The entry-candidate contract is an API fragment, not a DB artefact of this story.

disposition.change: Remove masking_rule from the P1 schema and V0001 (T3.6). P1 holds data_product_access only and takes the masking answer from POST /api/recovery/access/v1/authorise and FieldMasker of RWB-P4-E1037-CON, one hop, 2 s timeout.
disposition.note: This story already creates no masking row and reads none by SQL (BR6, AC7).

disposition.change: Specify one catalog contract: the P1 catalog API composes P1 product, field and access rows; owner roles and masking resolved through P4 (rwb-access); retention class through the P5 contract; no service copies another service's table.
disposition.note: The catalog composition is an API contract outside this DB story.
Story seeds only the six sourced rows, grants nothing by default, and assigns the rest to a steward-closed later load.

disposition.change: Add reference-data table code data_product_access as a load through the rwb-case contract, with a handler in rwb-source-data replacing DataProductAccessLoader; rwb-source-data exposes no load endpoint of its own.
disposition.note: The load path belongs to the rwb-case reference-data contract, not this story.
